name: life-dashboard
description: A dark, data-heavy personal dashboard that turns daily check-ins into visible progress across fitness, money and career, rewards consistency, and uses an AI advisor and forecasts to keep you on track.

paragraphs: A dark, data-heavy personal dashboard that turns daily check-ins into visible progress across fitness, money and career, rewards consistency, and uses an AI advisor and forecasts to keep you on track. Built for one user first (you), structured so it can be pitched later as a general self-improvement product.

requirements.text: Sign in on any device and the dashboard keeps itself in step: edits go up a few seconds after you stop, other devices are checked when you return to the app, go back online, and every minute while it is open.
The account password (email login, resettable) and the data passphrase are separate. "Keep this device unlocked" stores a non-extractable key in the browser instead of the passphrase.

Those need a server that holds each person's push subscription and sends on a schedule (and the content security policy and service worker would need extending), so they only make sense once there are real users.
